context: Full fresh unchanged existing unit-row-channel4-fallback-context-v1 object, including complete marked entry state, original_context and original language_binding. The repeated headers join literally to its fields; no new model/epoch authority.
prototype_census: Sorted list [[literal_type_id, full_existing_canonical_type_preimage_text], ...] copying the WHOLE existing original+decorated ledger. Canonical text uses ensure_ascii=False and must be parsed/compared as full literal data, not treated as a digest. Initial selected/excluded names plus every base-yielded original CANDIDATE processed, including channel4-removed types.
prefix_counts: Exact builtin cursor counters: original_yielded_candidates=_raw_count, yielded_candidates=_count, marked_removed=_removed; eof_reached=_done. No advance or counter recomputation/reset. A newly opened cursor can have state ledger entries with all counts0.
authority: complete_prefix_census=true means a full copy of this operative checked prefix ledger, NOT full candidate universe/completeness/degree/EOF certification. scope=CHECKED_STATE_AND_BASE_YIELDED_MARKED_CURSOR_PREFIX. All independent/degree/graph/scheduler/proof/resource acceptance fields false.
lifetime: Public method may be called after opening and every successful advance/EOF. Success only reads cursor state and returns fresh mutable containers. Native-first tick, per-entry tick and existing semantics.tree copy are charged to the same cumulative Root callback/bounds; no new cap, cache, clock, budget reset or late deadline extension.
failure: Already poisoned/aborted cursor raises RuntimeError before reading/export. Any callback/sort/copy/other BaseException during export sets the existing failed flag and propagates unchanged; no truncated successful packet. After failure no late export.
not_exported: Never-yielded private lower69 reconstructed prototypes rejected before a base CANDIDATE. No base69 source, originalmodel, marking, event/order/EOF/abort/legality or ordinary old API change.
composer_obligation: Merge the complete returned census into one selected/excluded/public/offer original+decorated ID/full-preimage ledger before retaining each head, extension, pair or preference. Do not merge alternatives' incompatible point unions. No composer or engine integration is implemented here.
